hook.say: This morning: ChatGPT Ads reached 89 countries, and over 100,000 advertisers have run campaigns. I went back in to check what those advertisers actually pay and get.

findings.label: CPM
findings.headline: One advertiser's CPM after nearly $70,000 of testing
findings.detail: Hostinger's tester said click-through rate worried him more than price. Broad messaging struggled.
findings.evidence: After nearly $70,000 in testing, Ograk reported CPMs above $65 but said CTR was a bigger concern.
findings.say: First, one advertiser spent nearly $70,000 testing ChatGPT Ads and saw CPMs above $65. His bigger worry was low click-through.

findings.label: CTR
findings.headline: ChatGPT ad click-through rate versus Google Search
findings.detail: Adthena data, as reported by The Keyword.
findings.evidence: Data from Adthena put ChatGPT's click-through rate at 0.91%, against 6.4% on Google Search.
findings.say: Second, Adthena data puts ChatGPT ad click-through at 0.91%. Google Search sits at 6.4%, so people click far less often.

findings.label: CPC
findings.headline: Median cost per click across 15 published campaigns
findings.detail: Range ran from $0.76 to $14.80, mostly US campaigns.
findings.evidence: CPC ranged from USD 0.76 to 14.8, and half were below USD 4.41.
findings.say: Third, a review of 15 published campaigns found a median click costs $4.41. The spread is wide, from $0.76 to $14.80.

take.headline: Check your citations before your budget.
take.say: My take: clicks cost real money and results vary widely. Measure whether AI already cites you before paying to be seen.

sources.title: Search Engine Journal – 6 Months Into ChatGPT Ads
The Keyword – ChatGPT Ads: How They Work and What They Cost
PPC One – International ChatGPT Ads results

caption:
This morning: ChatGPT Ads expanded to 89 countries, with over 100,000 advertisers. OpenAI says ads don't change the answer.

The deeper numbers: one tester saw CPMs above $65 after nearly $70,000 spent. Click-through is 0.91% versus 6.4% on Google Search. Median cost per click across 15 campaigns is $4.41.

My take: measure whether AI cites you before you decide how much to spend on media.
